title: Self-audit across the query family and fixed-task capability audits
description: The Family Module (#817, June 2026) and The Steganographic Bracket (#185) hold that single-rendering self-audit cannot see distributed erasure and that attribution is audited across a query family through FC, ASI and CC; #817 reserves a family composite until corpus runs exist, specifies a synthetic-family repair. Fixed-task capability audits (#142, #772) specify capacity loss tested before and after a retuning with the user held constant. Also here: the Self-Audit Module procedure (#780), cross-system PER measurement (#95), subjunctive addresses awaiting observation (#870, with #1084 recording priority), and claims (#1052, #1574) that models trained on anthologies and reference works inherit the discipline's erasure. The page also holds unrelated claims on a recrawl, metadata survival and a mirror-audit gate.

ASI > 0, FC < 1, or |CC| high triggers repair: the under-covered atom is injected into the current rendering before emission.
